note: A. Marion Churley (#1156) is already in the record, filed at 1 Western Terrace on the 1921 census as "Principal Of Schoo" — the return runs out mid-word. This fills her story and gives the occupation its full form. Her first name is left as the census has it: the importer fills blanks and never overwrites, so changing "A Marion" to "Ada Marion" is a person-page edit, not something this file should do quietly.
source: A. Hagues, from the history of Broadgate School; the 1921 census for the entry itself

people.bio: Miss Ada Churley, recorded on the 1921 census at 1 Western Terrace as the principal of a school, ran Broadgate School there. The school occupied 1 and 2 Western Terrace from 1921 until it closed on 4 March 1997 — seventy-six years in the same two houses, which is longer than any household the record holds.

occupations.notes: Returned on the 1921 census as "Principal Of Schoo", the word cut short by the column. The school's name is from A. Hagues.
